title: Rename is refused when the new number looks like a part stocked at this location
custom_preconds: Admin. Part X stocked here. Another part 4--PET-40 (other Part Library entry) also stocked here.
custom_steps:
1. Open part X in Edit Inventory Part
  2. Change Part Number to 4-PET-40 (same as 4--PET-40 ignoring punctuation)
  3. Save
custom_expected:
1. Dialog opens
  2. Value typed
  3. Dialog stays open; toast "4--PET-40 already exists at this location."; part X keeps its number everywhere
